senses.gloss: (= אזז √אז; cmp. אזל I; גז, חז, עז, חצד &c.) to be cut off; to go apart, be gone.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 34b">Sabb. 34ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. <he>ואזדו לטעמייהו</he> they differ (cmp. <cite ref="Q00935"><he>פלג</he></cite>), each following his own principle (or consistent with opinions elsewhere expressed).
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:5">Ned. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>שיתא אזדו</he> (Rashi <he>אזלו ליה</he>) six of them are gone (escaped his memory).
<cite ref="Meilah 17b">Meïl. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>נפק אזדא</he> Ar. (read <he>אזד</he>, ed. <cite ref="A00973"><he>אזל</he></cite>) he went out and away. V. <cite ref="A00973"><he>אֲזַל</he></cite>.
